source_name: Portál gov.cz — Změna zápisu v obchodním rejstříku (service description)
why_relevant: Authoritative procedural description of how and when a change of registered particulars must be filed ('bez zbytečného odkladu'), which forms (inteligentní formuláře) are used and which court is competent. Needed to calibrate the expected lag between a real-world leadership move and its register appearance — essential for dating claims correctly.

source_name: Kurzy.cz — Rejstřík firem (vazby a vztahy z justice.cz)
why_relevant: Commercial re-publisher of register data with two things the official register lacks: daily-updated derived views (newly created companies, unreliable VAT payers) and a graph of company-person relationships with time analysis ('vztahy k datu'). Lets you pivot from one bank executive to every other CZ entity where they sit — exactly the subsidiary/SPV discovery the cell rationale calls for.

source_name: Peníze.cz — Obchodní rejstřík / rejstrik.penize.cz
why_relevant: Another CZ aggregator of register + accounts data with person profiles and clean, stable per-IČO URLs. Useful as a cross-check when or.justice.cz session URLs are awkward to cite, and because it surfaces filed financial statements alongside statutory-body history.

source_name: Finmag.cz — obchodní rejstřík (Partners media register mirror)
why_relevant: Financial-media-hosted register mirror; relevant because it sits inside a finance publication, so register records and editorial coverage of the same bank/fintech are cross-linked — a cheap bridge from a filing to press narrative for the same entity.

source_name: Merk.cz — firemní databáze a monitoring
why_relevant: Named in the cell scope as a commercial register aggregator; positions itself as a CZ/SK company database with monitoring and API/CRM integrations over register data. Value for A5 is change-monitoring (alerts on statutory-body change) rather than raw data the state does not already publish. NOTE: I did not open merk.cz directly in this pass, so treat the URL as high-confidence-by-convention but unverified.

source_name: Sledovani-insolvence.cz — hlídání obchodního rejstříku
why_relevant: Commercial change-watch service: emails an alert when a monitored company's register entry changes, with a 30-day change digest and deep links into company history. Cheap off-the-shelf substitute for building your own OR diffing pipeline, and useful for benchmarking detection latency of a self-built one.

source_name: Cedcr.cz / insolvencni-rejstrik.cz — ISIR re-publishers
why_relevant: Third-party front ends over ISIR offering easier name-based lookup and monitoring than the official form. Useful only as a convenience/alerting layer; all findings must be confirmed in isir.justice.cz.

source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (data.gov.cz)
why_relevant: National open-data catalogue — the systematic way to discover further CZ registers and datasets relevant to corporate/organisational change (ARES, registers, statistical registers) that this cell has not yet enumerated, including datasets published by ČSÚ, MF and MSp.

source_name: BusinessInfo.cz — návody: zápis do obchodního rejstříku / veřejné rejstříky
why_relevant: State-backed business-information portal explaining exactly which documents must go into the Sbírka listin and which facts must be registered. Serves as the taxonomy reference for building an extraction schema for filed documents (what document types exist and what each implies about org change).

source_name: Apify — Obchodni Rejstrik Downloader (third-party scraper actor)
why_relevant: Off-the-shelf scraper actor for the CZ commercial register. Relevant mainly as evidence of how others solve the extraction problem and as a fallback if the official open data proves too coarse — but scraping or.justice.cz is inferior and riskier than using dataor.justice.cz/ARES API, so treat as low priority.

source_name: ČNB – Centrální úložiště regulovaných informací (CUri / OAM)
why_relevant: Czech Officially Appointed Mechanism: the statutory single repository where every CZ-listed issuer (Moneta, KB, ČSOB/Erste/RBI bond issuers) must file regulated information, including MAR inside information (vnitřní informace), AGM notices (oznámení o konání valné hromady) and annual/half-year reports whose governance chapters name board members. Highest-fidelity, calendar-driven A5 signal for leadership and organisational change.

source_name: ČNB – Informace zveřejňované emitenty (landing / documentation page)
why_relevant: Explains the 14 categories of regulated information collected (annual/half-year reports, AGM notifications, inside information, managers' transactions) and links both the current CUri application and the pre-2009 legacy archive. Defines the taxonomy a collector should filter on.

source_name: ČNB – Informační povinnost emitentů cenných papírů vůči ČNB
why_relevant: Sets out WHAT must be disclosed and on what deadlines under Act 256/2004 Sb. and MAR — i.e. the publication calendar that makes this cell forward-looking (AGM notice minimum 30 days ahead, inside information without undue delay).

source_name: Burza cenných papírů Praha (PSE/BCPP) – News / Exchange news feed
why_relevant: The exchange republishes issuer-related news and market notices for Prime Market issuers; the CZ/EN parallel feed is the fastest exchange-level trigger that something (incl. management change, delisting, restructuring) has been disclosed. Czech mirror at https://www.pse.cz/zpravy.

source_name: PSE issuer detail page – MONETA MONEY BANK (ISIN CZ0008040318)
why_relevant: Per-ISIN hub linking company profile, reports, presentations and the corporate calendar (AGM/results dates) and out to investors.moneta.cz. The corporate calendar gives dated forward notice of AGMs where board elections happen.

source_name: MONETA Money Bank – Investor Relations news / regulatory announcements
why_relevant: Primary MAR disclosure channel of the only CZ-headquartered listed bank. Publishes 'Public Disclosure of Inside Information' items, board/supervisory-board election results and reorganisation announcements in Czech AND English on the same page.

source_name: MONETA Money Bank – General Meeting (valná hromada) page
why_relevant: Holds AGM/EGM convocation notices (pozvánka na valnou hromadu) with the full agenda, candidate CVs for supervisory board / audit committee elections, and the post-meeting voting results — the rare forward-looking A5 signal, typically 30+ days before the appointment takes effect.

source_name: MONETA Money Bank – Corporate Governance (Správa společnosti)
why_relevant: Authoritative current roster of management board (představenstvo), supervisory board (dozorčí rada) and committees; diffing it over time detects departures/arrivals that were only lightly announced.

source_name: Komerční banka – Povinně uveřejňované informace (regulated disclosures hub)
why_relevant: KB is a PSE Prime Market issuer and SocGen subsidiary; this hub carries AGM convocations, securities information and the 'Zprávy' subsection with annual reports whose governance chapters list board changes. Confirmed to host the 2026 AGM notice PDF proposing four new supervisory-board members.

source_name: Komerční banka – Zprávy (annual/interim reports)
why_relevant: Annual and half-year reports contain the governance chapter: full board rosters with appointment/resignation dates, organisational structure charts and headcount (počet zaměstnanců) — a structured annual baseline for A5 organisation-change tracking.

source_name: ČSOB – Povinně uveřejňované informace
why_relevant: ČSOB is not equity-listed but is a Czech bond issuer on PSE and a KBC subsidiary; its statutory disclosure page carries prospectuses, emission supplements and CRR/Vyhláška 123/2007 disclosures that include governance and organisational-structure sections for the CZ entity.

source_name: Česká spořitelna – Dokumenty ke stažení (incl. povinně uveřejňované informace)
why_relevant: Erste's Czech subsidiary aggregates its mandatory disclosures and annual reports here; used to confirm CZ-entity board composition against Erste Group ad-hoc releases about Czech unit leadership.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG – Investor News / Announcements (ad-hoc, §17 MAR)
why_relevant: Parent of Česká spořitelna. MAR Art.17 inside-information releases and AGM resolutions announcing management/supervisory board changes; Erste routinely names CEOs of country units (incl. ČS) in these releases. English-first, machine-readable dates.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International AG – Ad-hoc Releases
why_relevant: Parent of Raiffeisenbank a.s. (CZ). Dedicated MAR ad-hoc release page — confirmed to carry CEO/CFO appointment announcements (e.g. CEO succession effective 1 July 2026). Group-level executive changes cascade into CZ-unit reorganisations.

source_name: Vienna Insurance Group – IR News / Inside Information (Ad-hoc)
why_relevant: VIG owns Kooperativa, ČPP and other CZ insurance/bancassurance operations. Its inside-information feed announces managing-board changes and country-organisation restructurings that reach the Czech market.

source_name: Société Générale – Board of Directors / governance and AGM releases
why_relevant: Parent of Komerční banka. Pre-announces director renewals/appointments proposed to the AGM (confirmed release for the 27 May 2026 AGM). SG board members frequently sit on KB's dozorčí rada, so SG's slate predicts KB supervisory-board changes weeks ahead.

source_name: KBC Group – Investor Relations / regulated information press releases
why_relevant: Parent of ČSOB CZ. Releases flagged 'Regulated information' cover Czech-division matters (e.g. ČSOB/ČMSS ownership, arbitration) and group management changes. KBC's IR policy states inside information is disclosed immediately, so timing is reliable.

source_name: EQS News – Ad-hoc distribution channel (Erste, VIG, Austrian issuers)
why_relevant: Regulatory distribution service used by Austrian parents (Erste, VIG) for MAR ad-hoc releases; carries the same legal text as the issuer site, in DE and EN, with stable permalinks — good redundancy and easier to poll than some IR sites.

source_name: RM-SYSTÉM – Zprávy od emitentů
why_relevant: The second Czech regulated/MTF venue republishes issuer announcements (incl. Komerční banka, Erste, Moneta) in Czech, with a deep paginated archive going back years — useful for backfilling a leadership-change timeline that PSE and IR sites have pruned. Also hosts issuer PDFs (e.g. Moneta AGM voting results).

source_name: Kurzy.cz – akcie CZ / emise (issuer news and ISIN pages)
why_relevant: Czech financial portal that mirrors PSE/RM-S issuer announcements and AGM coverage per ISIN, often with earlier indexing than the exchange pages; useful as a discovery tripwire pointing back to the primary filing.
